subject: Greenroom translation ops + speaker buddy rotation for BrightFin webinar
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Ruiz <ana@brightfin.co>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 8 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Greenroom translation ops + speaker buddy rotation for BrightFin webinar

Hi Ana —

Quick note while we lock final run-of-show for Jan 20: two operational asks from our side to make the live session smooth for multilingual attendees and to reduce last-minute handoffs for your panelists.

1) Simultaneous translation: we plan to enable English + Spanish audio channels for attendees. Can BrightFin confirm you have a vendor/interpretation feed or should Redwood spin up a relay channel to our vendor? If you have a feed, what connection type (RTMP / SIP / Zoom breakout)?

2) Greenroom buddy rotation: we propose pairing each external speaker with an internal buddy for pre-show checks and mid-session cueing. Attached is a draft buddy rotation CSV — model is 10-minute pre-check, mic check, and 1 backup contact during live Q&A.

Operationally we need:
- Confirmation of translation feed by EOD Monday (Jan 12)
- Speaker bio file (for host intro) and final slides by Wed (Jan 14)

Happy to hop on a 20-min ops touch if that's easier.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Event Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.ai

Attachments: greenroom-buddy-rotation.csv

From: Ana Ruiz <ana@brightfin.co>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcos Velasquez <marcos@brightfin.co>, BrightFin Events <events@brightfin.co>
Date: Fri, 9 Jan 2026 10:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Greenroom translation ops + speaker buddy rotation for BrightFin webinar

Hi Markus —

Thanks for the clear asks — we're aligned. Quick answers: 

1) Translation: we already contracted LinguaLive for simultaneous Spanish. They will provide an RTMP stream for the interpreter mix and an output channel. I copied Marcos from Events who will share the RTMP endpoint and creds by Monday morning.

2) Speaker assets: attached are the speaker bios (PDF) and an early version of slides (v1). Final slides will land by Tue noon (Jan 13) at the latest.

We like the buddy rotation idea. Can you confirm whether buddies need to join the speaker's private Zoom room or remain in Slack/Backchannel? LinguaLive will also want a sounding check with the lead interpreter on Tue Jan 13, 2pm ET. Does that work for Redwood?

Best,
Ana Ruiz
Head of Events | BrightFin
ana@brightfin.co

Attachments: brightfin_speaker_bios.pdf, v1_slide-deck.pptx
